title: Lifting a Register Run to the Memory Machine
statement: Let $K_0,B,P$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{orc}$ be a Boolean oracle on four indices and Boolean strings, and let $x$ be a Boolean string. Let $a,a'$ be register configurations, let $M:\mathbb{Z}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be memory, and let $p\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $0\le p\le P$, the register machine reaches $a'$ from $a$ with the guard $\mathrm{GuardLe}(\mathrm{Ad}(K_0),x,B)$ holding at every configuration strictly before the endpoint, and the control state of $a'$ is nonhalting. Then the memory machine reaches $(a',(M,p))$ from $(a,(M,p))$, with $G(x,B,P)$ holding at every configuration strictly before the endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean oracle on four indices and Boolean strings
Integer head position $p$ with $0\le p\le P$
Register run from $a$ to $a'$ satisfies $\mathrm{GuardLe}(\mathrm{Ad}(K_0),x,B)$ at all strictly prior configurations
The control component of $a'$ is nonhalting
replaced:
Let $K_0,B,P\in\mathbb{N}$, fix a four-index Boolean oracle, an input bit string $x$,
register configurations $a,a'$, memory contents $M$, and a head position
$p\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $0\le p\le P$, the deterministic register machine reaches $a'$
from $a$ while its guard holds at every preceding configuration, and the control
component of $a'$ is nonhalting. Then the memory machine reaches $(a',(M,p))$ from
$(a,(M,p))$ while satisfying $G(x,B,P)$ throughout the run.
